stage: before reading 04 NAV outputs; 03 published price-extreme fact already known
valuation: Only latest completed prior UTC daily close; require exact previous day, no carrying across missing candle. No price interpolation. Event dates distinguish candle from next-day observed NAV.
daily_sampling: Last LP snapshot of each UTC day; retain its actual timestamp. Missing LP days remain missing; daily returns only adjacent UTC dates. Intraday drawdown is sampled-close mark-to-model, not executable value.
event_metrics: Fixed-baseline maximum sampled loss and quantity changes, event peak-to-trough, first recovery to baseline sustained for three consecutive daily observations within fixed recovery horizon. Right-censor if not recovered. Report no-pending and static single-exit lower-envelope sensitivity separately.
other_periods: Entire frozen common window descriptive peak-to-trough and 1%/5% empirical daily return quantiles; calendar-year buckets if useful. Never optimize start/end or rank candidate windows. Quantiles are descriptive, not future loss guarantees.
event_clustering: March 2023 USDC/USDT/LP and all venues are one shared risk-event complex. Calendar bins, rows, coins and daily losses are not independent trials; no automatic claim of 30 independent results.
recovery_price_marker: First three consecutive source-candle closes with USDC >=0.995 after event start; merely a fixed USD quote marker, distinct from LP recovery.
missing: Any required missing price invalidates that NAV row; missing days break sustained-recovery runs. No substitute parity or interpolation. Disclose all gaps.
correlation: Do not infer low trend correlation from stablecoin low volatility. Without independently aligned frozen trend benchmark return series, report not identified rather than construct a proxy.
ohlc_sensitivity: Daily lows/highs are non-synchronous source sensitivities only, not jointly executable portfolio prices; 2023-03-11 USDC 0.80526 is not own fill.
